transcript.text: Hi, we've just had a Bosch KGN36VLEAG delivered last week and it makes a gurgling, bubbling sound like water running, plus a click every so often and a crack noise at night. Is it faulty? It's driving my husband mad.

It is very unlikely to be faulty. The gurgling and bubbling you hear is the refrigerant moving through the pipes, which sounds exactly like water running. The clicking is likely the compressor starting or stopping as part of its normal cycle, and the cracking noises at night are just the plastic interior expanding and contracting as temperatures change. These are all standard behaviours for a new fridge-freezer. The only time these sounds indicate a problem is if the appliance stops cooling properly (the fridge gets warm) or if you see an oily residue on the floor, which would suggest a leak. If it is keeping food cold and there is no oil, you can safely ignore the noise.

candidates: Normal refrigerant flow and plastic expansion (high)

Then give the one or two safe checks, or the one question, that would best tell those causes apart. Do not ask for the model number in this reply. Do not tell them to buy, order or replace a part yet.
